title: Amit Shah's Hyderabad visit jammed the Old City and central roads for hours
body: Amit Shah's visit to the Bhagya Laxmi temple near Charminar and a Maha Padayatra supporting SIR caused severe congestion across the Old City and central Hyderabad on Monday for several hours (Telangana Today).

steps.e: Visit to Bhagya Laxmi temple near Charminar
Severe congestion for several hours, Old City and central Hyderabad
